description: Synthetic sesslint.finding parity (exported names, content-free text, SourceRef, ordering, constructors, parsing).

known_parity_gaps.detail: When make_finding omits a fingerprint hash, Python uses sesslint.determinism.canonical_json_bytes; Rust returns exactly 'sesslint.determinism.canonical_json_bytes is not available' and does not build a digest. Parity does not assert a hex digest.
get_finding_schema_path and load_finding_schema require sesslint._resources.schema_path; Rust returns 'sesslint._resources.schema_path is not available' and does not read schemas/.
Python set and frozenset order is not stable; which bad related_ids item is reported first is not a required vector. A successful related_ids result is still sorted.
A non-string evidence variant: Python typing.cast returns the raw value; Rust returns FindingError. Not a required vector.
Template line strings that use Unicode Nd digits are rejected by Rust. Not a required vector.
An explicit bool ordinal is not representable in Rust. Not a required vector.
Lone surrogates and integers outside i64 are not representable. Not a required vector.
Finding.from_dict raises KeyError, ValueError, or TypeError in Python and FindingError in Rust; exception type parity is not required.
FingerprintContext has only adapter_id, adapter_version, profile_id, and profile_version; the rest of CheckContext is not required.
